# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia m155 and HarfBuzz refresh** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 and the HarfBuzz 14.4 shaping update. The line retires RAW/DNG decoding and includes Ganesh failed-flush cache cleanup plus a fontconfig candidate-order correction.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use an external decoder for RAW and DNG images** — Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode these files externally before passing pixels to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))
- **Review cross-direction text layout after the HarfBuzz update** — HarfBuzz 14.4 intentionally changes cross-direction mark positioning for DirectWrite and Core Text compatibility. Review text layouts and rendering baselines that depend on the previous shaping output before upgrading. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m155** — Updates the bundled renderer to m155 while preserving existing rotation-scale text-run bounds behavior and the managed binding surface. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081))
- **HarfBuzz 14.4 shaping and font handling** — Updates native HarfBuzz from 14.2.1 to 14.4.0, including glyph-position saturation and malformed-font crash and hang fixes. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums; raw fetch functions remain internal without new Face wrappers. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed flushes discard unusable cached textures** — Ganesh drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed flush, preventing later draws from reusing entries for textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))
- **Fontconfig respects requested-family order** — Tests family acceptability only on the first valid sorted candidate instead of scanning onward to a lower-ranked metric-compatible substitute, allowing the caller to try the next requested family. ([#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 with cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font fixes, and shaping/subsetting performance work. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums while keeping raw fetch functions internal.
